svg.title: Jisakuna — pastel cat name sticker
svg.desc: An original-reference vector conversion with transparent outer canvas, pink English lettering, a single mauve Japanese name line, cream cat, hearts, yellow stars, and a teacup. All artwork is made of editable vector paths; there are no embedded raster images or font dependencies.

g.inkscape:label: Hearts, dotted heart, blush cheeks, and tea cup
